name: Algeciras (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Algeciras (a tower on red above waves, within a wreath).
history: The flag of Algeciras is rectangular, its length three halves of its width, divided into two equal horizontal stripes, yellow above and blue below; it originates in the flag of the maritime province of Algeciras.

features.role: Algeciras arms — tower above waves within a wreath
